title: Minimum standards for a WA rental
description: Safety and security standards a WA rental must meet before a tenancy. Summarised from Consumer Protection and Building and Energy guidance.

sources.title: Smoke alarm laws for homes being sold, rented and hired
Electrical safety when renting or hiring (fact sheet)
Councils urged to stay buoyant on pool barrier inspections

items.title: Smoke alarms are permanently connected to mains power
items.detail: A 10-year sealed battery alarm only where there is no space to run wiring.

items.title: Each smoke alarm is no more than 10 years old and not past its expiry date
Alarms are interconnected where there is more than one (building permit applied for from 1 May 2015)
At least two RCDs protect all power and lighting circuits
Main entry door has a deadlock or an AS 5039-2008 security screen door
Other external doors have a deadlock, patio bolt or compliant security screen door
Windows that can be reached from outside lock so they can't be opened from outside
An electric light at or near the main entry can be switched on from inside
items.detail: Not needed for an apartment where the strata company looks after lighting.

items.title: Pool or spa barrier complies and gates self-close and latch
Have a licensed gas fitter check gas appliances (recommended)
Use licensed electrical contractors for electrical repairs and smoke alarm wiring
